name: Teethyz Dentist
desc:
"Where every smile counts." 

Here at Teethyz, we strive to provide quality service and great hospitality to our clients! From our refreshing cleanings to pain-free brace fittings, our incredible staff ensures your entire visit is satisfactory! You can even become a dentist yourself and work your way up to be the most skilled employee so that you can showcase your friends. ✏️ 

How do you get a job?
🦷 Join the group!
✏️ Take an application in the "Apply" experience.
📋 Attend a training in the "Training" experience. 

📌 Public Information: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/teethyz-dentist-public-handbook
